title: Same calories, different fuel
question: Why do two meals of equal size move glucose so differently?
expectedObservation: The carbohydrate-heavy meal sends glucose higher and keeps it up longer. In this model only the carbohydrate drives the glucose curve: the protein and fat take other routes (portal vein and lymph), and the model does not include how they slow digestion, so the real difference is likely larger.

meal.description: Carbohydrate-heavy breakfast: 78 g carbohydrate, 9 g protein, 5 g fat
Protein-and-fat breakfast: 45 g carbohydrate, 25 g protein, 12.5 g fat
